The dataset contains 4600 multimodal tweets with a test set size of 500 examples with a 50% split between the two classes: • Similar: The image and text share the same focus and attempt to convey the same message. There exists a significant overlap in the information conveyed between modalities. • Complementary: The image and text do not share the same focus, but one modality helps understand the other better. Both modalities provide independent information which when combined, provide a more complete picture of the message/event. There may be divergence in the information conveyed between modalities.
guideline: Annotators assigned coherence relations based on predefined categories and communicative functions (e.g., Similar, Complementary, Insertion, etc.).
A coherence relation captures the structural, logical, and purposeful relationships between an image and its text, capturing the author's intent.
